answer:
The actor who portrayed Jerry Lee Lewis in the 1989 film "Great Balls of Fire!" is **Dennis Quaid**. His current spouse is **Laura Savoie**, whom he married in June 2020. They co-founded a production company called Bonnieedale Films together. 

Quaid has been married four times previously, including to actresses P.J. Soles (1978–1983), Meg Ryan (1991–2001), and Kimberly Buffington (2004–2016).
